This app blocks known betting website names. It cannot promise to stop every betting site or app: new sites, other VPN apps, Private DNS and secure-DNS browser settings can get around it. Keep reporting new sites.

Lists are checked every ~12 hours when internet is available. A new list is used only if it downloads completely and its digital signature is valid; otherwise the previous list stays in use. Entries come from reviewed reports and public gambling blocklists.
Only blocked website names are remembered, on this phone only. Tap one for details.
Digital signature check: ON (updates must be signed)
Digital signature check: OFF (updates are only protected by HTTPS)
The update address has not been set in this build, so only the built-in list is used.
Update failed, the previous list is still in use. (%1$s)
The website name %1$s was blocked because it matches the blocklist entry: %2$s\n\nIf this is a normal website that should not be blocked, report it as a mistake.
This checks whether any app from the known betting-app list is installed on this phone.

Android does not allow a normal app to stop another app from opening, or to prevent a betting APK from being installed. This screen can only detect known apps and help you uninstall them. Apps missing from the list will not be found.
No known betting app was found (checked against %1$d known apps).

Open the app and tap Turn on. For the strongest result, set this app as Always-on VPN in Android VPN settings. Then Android restarts protection by itself. Only one VPN can be active at a time, so turning on another VPN app turns this protection off.

Some phones, including Vivo, stop background apps to save battery. Allow this app to run in the background and set battery use to Unrestricted. On Vivo: Settings > Battery > Background power consumption management > Betting Shield BD > Allow high background power consumption; also allow Autostart.

The filter works by checking website names. If your phone Private DNS is set to a provider name, or your browser has Secure DNS turned on (Chrome: Settings > Privacy and security > Use secure DNS), the names are not checked here. Use Private DNS Off/Automatic and turn the browser option off.

• It cannot block a website that is not in the list, or one reached by its numeric IP address.
• Another VPN, a changed Private DNS or secure-DNS browser setting can bypass it.
• It cannot stop uninstalling or force-stopping, and cannot prevent every betting app from installing or running.
• Shared hosting and new mirror domains can cause missed sites or, rarely, a wrong block; use Report to fix both.
• It should never be installed on another person's phone without their knowledge and permission.

• VPN connection: runs the local website-name filter. No traffic leaves your phone through it.
• Internet: downloads list updates and sends reports.
• Notifications: tells you when protection stops.
• Start at boot: turns protection back on after restart.
• See installed apps: compares your apps with the known betting-app list, on the phone only.
• Uninstall apps: opens the normal Android uninstall screen; you must confirm.

Website names are checked on your phone and are not uploaded. Only recently BLOCKED names are kept, on your phone, so you can review them. A report sends only the website address, an optional note and a random report number. Nothing about your banking, accounts or other browsing is collected.

Blocking is only a tool. Talking to a trusted family member or friend, and to a doctor or mental-health professional (for example at the National Institute of Mental Health in Dhaka), makes recovery far more likely. You are not alone and it is okay to ask for help.
